name: org.machanism.machai:machai
description: Machai is a multi-module Java toolkit for GenAI-enabled developer automation. The Maven parent coordinates Project Layout, provider-neutral GenAI client APIs, a reusable Model Context Protocol runtime, Bindex semantic library metadata and discovery, Ghostwriter guidance-driven repository processing, Python integration, Maven plugins, and ready-to-run MCP server distributions. It is suited to AI-assisted software engineering workflows that need to inspect source code, tests, Markdown documentation, configuration, diagrams, and other project files; expose Java functions as MCP tools; use generative AI and embeddings; discover reusable libraries semantically; and automate actions consistently in Maven builds or command-line workflows.

classification.type: Maven parent project and multi-module developer automation toolkit
usageContext: MCP tool servers over STDIO or HTTP
Java applications using generative AI providers and embeddings
Semantic artifact discovery and Bindex registration

features.name: Project layout detection
features.description: Detects Maven, Gradle, JavaScript or TypeScript, Python, or fallback project layouts and configures the selected layout with the supplied directory.

examples.description: Create a project directory reference and detect its conventional layout before passing it to a Machai project processor.

features.name: MCP server entry point
features.signature: public static void org.machanism.machai.mcp.server.McpServer.main(java.lang.String[] args) throws java.lang.Exception
features.description: Starts the Machai Model Context Protocol server in STDIO mode by default or HTTP mode when a port option is supplied.

examples.description: Run the server with functional tool implementations on the classpath and expose MCP capabilities over HTTP on port 45000.

features.name: Semantic Bindex retrieval
features.signature: public java.util.Collection<org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexInfo> org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.Picker.pick(java.lang.String prompt, long vectorSearchLimits, double score, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator configurator) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Classifies a natural-language request, generates an embedding, and queries a configured Bindex repository for relevant library metadata.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.Picker picker = new org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.Picker(repository, configurator);
java.util.Collection<org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexInfo> matches = picker.pick("Java MCP server with semantic library discovery", 10L, 0.75d, configurator);
examples.description: Use a configured repository and GenAI configurator to retrieve libraries that meet a natural-language architecture request.

customizations.name: MCP functional tools
customizations.description: Implementations of org.machanism.machai.process.tools.FunctionTools can provide methods annotated as tools, prompts, or resources for GenAI providers and MCP server runtimes.

examples.description: Package a FunctionTools implementation in a runtime library, place it beside the MCP runtime, and start the STDIO server for an MCP client.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.process.provider.ProcessProvider
studs.description: Provider boundary implemented by concrete AI provider integrations; the abstract base implementation centralizes configuration, tool registration, prompt registration, MCP setup, web search setup, and usage accounting.

examples.title: Build the complete toolkit from source
steps: Install JDK 17 or newer, Apache Maven 3.8.1 or newer, and Git.
Clone the repository with git clone https://github.com/machanism-org/machai.git.
Change into the machai directory and run mvn clean verify.
Use the resulting reactor artifacts or install them locally with mvn clean install.
examples.description: This builds the Maven parent and all coordinated libraries, plugins, and server modules.

examples.title: Generate Bindex metadata through the Maven plugin
steps: Configure the AI provider, model, credentials, Bindex repository, and tool-specific settings required by the workflow.
Invoke the aggregated Bindex Maven goal from the project root.
Review the generated metadata and register it through the configured Bindex workflow when appropriate.
examples.description: The Maven plugin delegates Bindex generation to the Machai workflow for a Maven project or reactor.

examples.title: Run a Ghostwriter Act through Maven
steps: Add or resolve the GW Maven plugin version 1.4.2 in the target Maven build.
Configure the selected GenAI provider and its credentials.
Run an Act with a focused file path so the workflow processes only the intended source area.
Review generated changes and execute project tests before committing.
examples.command: mvn org.machanism.machai:gw-maven-plugin:act -Dgw.act="review Focus on public APIs" -Dgw.path=src/main/java
examples.description: This practical automation scenario invokes Ghostwriter from Maven to review a selected Java source tree.
